# Temporary Files Directory

This directory is used for temporary files, work-in-progress content, and scratch documents that are part of the repository but not ready for publication.
page_texts.2:
[.tmp/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

- Temporary analysis files
- Draft documents under review
- Work-in-progress content
- Build artifacts and generated files
- Development scratch space
page_texts.3:
[.tmp/README.md#note]

## Note

Files in this directory may be cleaned up periodically. Do not store important files here permanently.
